reuse.why: Only getNextDate gets the new rule; getUpcomingDates and the budget template each re-decide 'daily + skipWeekend means skip' with their own condition instead of sharing a weekend-adjustment function.

duplication.why: The daily-skip rule is written three times (getNextDate's skipsWeekendDays from the new isDaily data flag, schedule-template's isDailySkipped from config, getUpcomingDates' own loop filtering d.isWeekend), and the template's two copied nextDate ternaries are both edited in place.

placement.why: The core rule sits in shared/schedules.ts, but the same rule is also embedded in the server schedules app and budget template, and a derived isDaily flag is stored on RSchedule data in rule-utils.

scope.why: Changes stay on the weekend-handling paths plus a test and release note, though encoding isDaily into recurrence data is an extra moving part.

maintainability.why: A future change to which frequencies skip versus move must be found and kept consistent in three differently-shaped places, and the template's negated flag passed as noSkipWeekend is hard to follow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates iterates occurrences and filters weekends itself instead of going through the shared getNextDate/getDateWithSkippedWeekend path

disguised_duplication.where: Weekend-skip filtering is reshaped per site: .filter(notWeekend) over take:7 in shared getNextDate, a for-of loop with d.isWeekend in schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates, and a renamed isDailySkipped boolean in budget/schedule-template.ts

one_place.where: Rule decided separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate (schedule.data.isDaily set in rules/rule-utils.ts parseRecurDate), server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates (config.frequency === 'daily'), and server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList (isDailySkipped)
